---
title: "Project, contact and use"

PEExcel was developed by the [Climate-fit Buildings and Districts](https://www.technikum-wien.at/forschungsschwerpunkt-renewable-energy-systems/) research group at [UAS Technikum Wien](https://www.technikum-wien.at/).

## Project context and funding

PEExcel development took place, among other activities, within the **teaching competence team “KlimSta – Klimafitte Stadtsanierung”** (climate-fit urban refurbishment) and work on the **klimaaktiv quality standard for positive energy districts**.

KlimSta was funded by the **City of Vienna — Municipal Department 23 (Economic Affairs, Labour and Statistics)** under “Stiftungsprofessuren und Kompetenzteams für Lehre”, Call 35.

![City of Vienna](../illustrations/stadtwien.png){width=180px fig-alt="Funding body: City of Vienna"}

Submit technical questions, bug reports and suggestions through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/simonschaluppe/peexcel/issues). For technical questions about klimaaktiv declarations, use the official contacts in the documentation and the programme's information services.

## Newsletter

The **klimaaktiv PEQ Kompetenzpartner Newsletter** covers tool updates, events, training and declaration developments.

[Subscribe to the newsletter](https://flow.cleverreach.com/fl/e24548f3-b4ae-4851-a0c2-bff4d05092ef/)

## Repository and contributions

| Area | Contents |
|---|---|
| `excel/tool`, `excel/development` | Stable and development files |
| `src/pexl` | Import, export, validation, analysis and visualisation |
| `notebooks` | Executable how-tos, analysis and validation |
| `data/schemas`, `data/examples` | Schemas and example/test data |
| `docs` | Reports, presentations and development documentation |
| `website` | This Quarto user documentation |
| `tests`, `pyproject.toml` | Checks and Python project configuration |

[Repository](https://github.com/simonschaluppe/peexcel) · [Changelog](https://github.com/simonschaluppe/peexcel/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md) · [Project guidelines](https://github.com/simonschaluppe/peexcel/blob/master/AGENTS.md)
